The card states only what the named sources say, says where a story is Kinzie family tradition rather than a contemporary account, and stages no speech or ceremony.

persons.name: Waubansee

present_on_scene_date.note: Wau-Bun places him at Chicago on the 15th and 16th; nothing dates his arrival. No source takes a roll call on the afternoon of 14 August 1812; this is read from the evidence below.

persons.note: Chief; friend of the Kinzies. Potawatomi (with Chippewa and Ottawa), Fox River band of about thirty men in May 1812. 15 and 16 August: with Winnemeg tried to save Wells (Wau-Bun, hearsay). 16th: sentinel at Kinzie house; Black Partridge spoke to him in the parlour (Wau-Bun). Afterwards: Opposed war in 1832 (Quaife index: 'Wabansia, opposed to war, 324').
